purpose: Qualify the coordinate and sign mapping from the already qualified J1B-R1 downward-positive Ross harness response tangent to the native SWAP 4.3.1 qbot convention, without changing the frozen C1R face family, fixtures, finite-difference factors, seam policy, or production cost model.

scope.physical_family: qualified C1R base MvG/KSATFIT face family only

relevant_statements: line 606: qbot = -1.0d0 * kmean(numnod+1) for free drainage
line 622: F(NN) = F(NN) - qbot for flux bottom boundary
line 137: qbot = -1.0d0 * kmean(numnod+1) for free drainage

legacy_source_authority.sign_conclusion: native SWAP qbot is positive upward / inflow from below and negative for downward free drainage

coordinate_mapping.swap_interface_flux: qbot, positive upward / inflow from below
coordinate_mapping.derivation: J1B solves J dh/dq_down = +e_N. Since q_down=-qbot, J dh/dqbot = -e_N.

frozen_seam_policy.trial_crosses_node: route or fallback; do not average
frozen_seam_policy.exact_equal_head_shortcut: separate branch; no cross-branch tangent claim

hard_gates: all 72 frozen J1B-R1 base cases remain valid
q_down = -qbot is applied exactly and only at the external interface coordinate
all 143 smooth symmetric finite differences are performed directly in native SWAP qbot coordinates and satisfy tangent metric <= 1e-5
the one frozen O01 node crossing is reproduced with the qbot plus/minus directions reversed relative to J1B-R1 and is excluded from the smooth metric
d_h_bottom/d_qbot is positive in all 72 smooth base cases
base profiles and shared tables remain bitwise unchanged
production candidate cost remains exactly one factorization, one normal backsolve and one additional qbot-tangent backsolve per base case
no extra nonlinear trajectory is required to obtain the production qbot tangent
prohibited: averaging across the O01 node crossing
Phi tuning or MFP normalization-line work

exit_rule.fail: Keep J1 interface mapping incomplete and classify the failure without tuning the C1R representation or frozen perturbations.
